picks.file: Central Kostroma from behind Volga river.jpg
picks.what: The city center and the kremlin seen across the Volga, photograph
picks.why: general view from across the river with the kremlin cathedrals and bell tower (demolished 1934); printed caption trimmed

picks.what: Susanin Square with the fire tower, photograph
picks.why: the city’s best-known square: trading arcades, fire lookout tower and guardhouse

notes: #2’s caption is in pre-1918 spelling, but the 1928–34 dating holds up: a statue on a tall pedestal is visible left of center, matching the Lenin monument set on the unfinished Romanov pedestal in 1928, and the kremlin cathedrals still stand (demolished 1934). #1 (Petrovichev painting) is dated only by the artist’s death in 1947 and its category points to the Ipatiev Monastery, so skipped. #5 (23,500 px Volga panorama) is too thin to read; #3 is mostly dark water.
